description: This file contains benchmark tests for the absl::StrSplit function, including various delimiter configurations and performance measurements.

methods.name: MakeTestString
methods.description: Creates a test string of specified length with semicolons inserted at intervals.

methods.name: BM_Split2StringView
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into string_view tokens using a single delimiter.

methods.name: MakeMultiDelimiterTestString
methods.description: Creates a test string with multiple delimiters cycling through a set.

methods.name: BM_Split2StringViewByAnyChar
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string with multiple delimiters using ByAnyChar.

methods.name: BM_Split2StringViewLifted
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into string_view tokens with a fixed delimiter, measuring performance.

methods.name: BM_Split2String

methods.name: BM_Split2SplitStringUsing
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting with SkipEmpty option, comparing to SplitStringUsing.

methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into an unordered_set of strings.

methods.name: BM_SplitStringToUnorderedMap
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string into an unordered_map of string key-value pairs.

methods.name: BM_SplitStringAllowEmpty
methods.description: Benchmark for splitting a string allowing empty tokens.

methods.name: OneCharStringLiteral
